seoDescription: Learn to expertly configure and automate shipping for your WooCommerce store. This tutorial provides a step-by-step guide to setting up dynamic shipping rates based on order total price and customer location. Discover how to create distinct shipping zones for different countries, like the United States and the Netherlands, and implement tiered pricing rules. You'll also learn how to set free shipping thresholds and use a 'left for free shipping' notice to increase average order value, creating a flexible and automated system for your customers.

chapters.description: This chapter covers the initial setup in WooCommerce settings, including defining selling locations and installing the essential "Flexible Shipping" plugin by Octolyze.

chapters.description: Learn how to create a new shipping zone for the United States and add the "Flexible Shipping" method, renaming it and setting a free shipping threshold.

chapters.title: Defining Price-Based Shipping Tiers for the US
chapters.description: This section demonstrates how to configure tiered shipping costs based on the cart's total price for the US shipping zone.

chapters.title: Testing US Shipping & Adding a Free Shipping Notice
chapters.description: See the shipping rules in action on the cart page and learn how to enable a notice that tells customers how much more they need to spend to get free shipping.

chapters.title: Finalizing the Free Shipping Rule
chapters.description: This chapter addresses a small glitch when reaching the free shipping threshold and shows how to fix it by adding an explicit rule for free shipping.

chapters.title: Configuring International Shipping (Netherlands)

chapters.title: Final Demo and Conclusion
chapters.description: Watch a final demonstration of the automated system dynamically changing rates based on the selected country and cart total, followed by a summary of the tutorial.

summary:
## Core Concept: Automating Shipping
This tutorial demonstrates how to set up automated, conditional shipping rates in WooCommerce. The goal is to create a system where shipping costs automatically adjust based on factors like the **customer's location** and the **total price of their order**.

## Step 1: Install the Required Plugin
WooCommerce's default shipping options are limited. To create advanced, price-based rules, you need a specialized plugin.

> [!NOTE]
> The plugin used in this tutorial is **Flexible Shipping for WooCommerce** by Octolyze (found by searching for "Table Rate"). It adds a new "Flexible Shipping" method to your shipping zones.

## Step 2: Create Shipping Zones
Shipping Zones allow you to apply different rules to different geographic areas. 

1.  Navigate to **WooCommerce > Settings > Shipping > Shipping Zones**.
2.  Click **Add shipping zone**.
3.  Give the zone a name (e.g., "United States") and select the corresponding region(s) from the dropdown.

## Step 3: Configure Shipping Methods & Rules
For each shipping zone, you'll add and configure a "Flexible Shipping" method.

### Base Settings
*   **Method Title**: Change the title to something customer-facing, like the name of your carrier (e.g., **UPS**).
*   **Free Shipping**: Set a **minimum order amount** to enable free shipping (e.g., `$200`).

### Pricing Rules
*   Set the calculation to be based on **Price**.
*   Add rules to create shipping tiers. Each rule defines a cost for a specific price range.
*   **Example for USA Zone:**
    *   `$0` to `$19.99`: Cost **$4.95**
    *   `$20` to `$49.99`: Cost **$7.95**
    *   `$50` to `$199.99`: Cost **$12.95**

> [!TIP]
> Enable the **"Display notice with the amount left for free shipping"** option. This is a powerful marketing tool that encourages customers to add more items to their cart to qualify for free shipping.

## Step 4: Test and Refine
Always test your rules by adding products to the cart and changing the quantities to ensure the shipping costs update correctly.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> To prevent a "No shipping options were found" error when a cart meets the free shipping threshold, add one final rule to your price tiers: **When price is from `[your free shipping amount]` on, set the cost to `0`**. This explicitly defines the free shipping option within the ruleset.

## Step 5: Replicate for Other Regions
To set up different rates for another country (e.g., the Netherlands):

1.  Create a **new shipping zone** for that country.
2.  Add a **new Flexible Shipping method**.
3.  Set a new, likely different, **free shipping threshold** (e.g., `$300`).
4.  Define a completely **new set of price-based rules** to reflect international shipping costs.

The system will automatically apply the correct rules based on the customer's selected shipping country.
